home.title: Sign Bitcoin with telephone tones, on a device you build yourself
home.lede: A signer that speaks DTMF, the beeps of a telephone keypad. A cheap microcontroller and a few parts from an electronics shop, or from the scrapyard, are enough.
home.urtones: It speaks ur-tones, an open way to send data as sound:
home.keypad_hint: Press a key: each is two tones at once, one from each group.
